package.name: zero_control
package.description: End-effector (SE(3)) control for ZERO. Converts the 20-dim cross-embodiment action (per hand: pos3 + rot6d + grip1) into joint position commands via damped-least-squares IK, for any robot in zero_layout.ROBOTS. One node for source and target embodiments, so a control-code difference cannot be mistaken for a transfer result.
